profile.equipmentDescription: Select the equipment you have available for training

equipmentHints.assisted: Machine with a counterweight that assists pull-ups and dips
equipmentHints.band: Rubber loop band: plate substitute, pull-up assistance, warm-up
equipmentHints.barbell: Long ~20 kg bar with plates: bench press, squats, deadlifts
equipmentHints.body weight: Exercises without gear: push-ups, pull-ups, squats
equipmentHints.bosu ball: Half-ball dome for balance and core work
equipmentHints.cable: Pulley station with weight stacks: rows, crossovers, raises in any plane
equipmentHints.dumbbell: Short hand weights: fixed or adjustable pairs
equipmentHints.ez barbell: Wavy curved bar, easier on the wrists: curls, skull crushers
equipmentHints.hammer: Sledgehammer for tire strikes: strength and endurance
equipmentHints.kettlebell: Cast-iron ball with a handle: swings, goblet squats, Turkish get-ups
equipmentHints.leverage machine: Seated lever machine: leg press, leg curls and extensions
equipmentHints.medicine ball: Heavy weighted ball: throws, twists, explosive work
equipmentHints.olympic barbell: Competitive 220 cm / 20 kg bar with rotating sleeves: snatch, clean and jerk
equipmentHints.resistance band: Flat elastic band for pulling movements and warm-ups
equipmentHints.roller: Foam roller for self-massage and muscle release (myofascial release)
equipmentHints.rope: Thick rope: climbing or battle ropes
equipmentHints.skierg machine: Simulates cross-country skiing poling, upper-body cardio
equipmentHints.sled machine: Platform sliding on inclined rails (45° leg press)
equipmentHints.smith machine: Bar fixed in vertical rails: strictly up-and-down movement
equipmentHints.stability ball: Large gym ball: core training and exercise support
equipmentHints.stepmill machine: Endless moving staircase: cardio and legs
equipmentHints.trap bar: Hexagonal bar you stand inside: back-friendly deadlifts
equipmentHints.weighted: Any added weight: dip belt, vest or ankle weights
equipmentHints.wheel roller: Small wheel with handles: ab rollouts
